title: A Reproducible Protocol for Resource-Aware Predictive Process Monitoring: Compact Baselines, a Simulator Blueprint, and Pitfalls

contributions.purpose: 给PPM一个防泄漏、确定性的可复现实验协议
contributions.mechanism: 按case起始时间做时序70/15/15切分、仅训练集归一化、固定种子42、只保留lifecycle=complete、自动artifact日志
contributions.evaluation: 定性(方法学);声称跨run方差降低、可一键复现
contributions.source_quote: A leakage-safe, deterministic protocol with chronological case splits, train-only normalization, fixed seeds, and automatic artifact logging.

contributions.mechanism: 单层LSTM(embed 64/hidden 128/dropout 0.2),输入前缀+5连续特征,Adam 1e-3,10 epoch
contributions.evaluation: 三公开日志 Top-3 0.987-0.994,Top-1 0.757-0.833,macro F1 仅0.474-0.587(尾类系统性误分);BPI2012有train-val gap过拟合
contributions.source_quote: Baseline next-activity results are strong (Top-3 0.987-0.994; Top-1 0.757-0.833), exposing systematic confusions that motivate resource context.

contributions.purpose: 资源中心agent蓝图+评测指标(未跑通)
contributions.mechanism: 每资源多项logistic策略+离散事件仿真(DES)+FIFO消融;新指标:全局next-event精度、每资源next-task精度、workload MAPE
contributions.evaluation: 负结果:本版**未报端到端仿真指标**,仅释放设计接口,C3核心贡献未实证
contributions.source_quote: we do not claim state-of-the-art accuracy nor report end-to-end simulator metrics in this version.

contributions.purpose: 记录实践陷阱与检查表
contributions.mechanism: lifecycle配对、类不平衡back-off、pandas整数索引off-by-one bug、artifact字段缺失致空图等
contributions.source_quote: Pitfalls and checklists observed in practice (e.g., lifecycle pairing under partial traces; imbalance-aware back-offs).

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike prior case-centric LSTMs [2,3,8], our work positions a reproducible bridge: retain the case-centric predictor as a modular component, but incorporate per-resource policies and a discrete-event simulator for concurrent execution.

notes: 负结果/非实证适配问题:论文自我限定为protocol+baseline+blueprint,**核心的resource-aware仿真(C3)未实现也未评测**——checklist Limitations自承"it could not implement the proposed idea fully autonomously"。基线macro F1低(0.47-0.59)、BPI2012过拟合为已报明的短板。数据诚实度较高(无造数迹象)。checklist AI披露:Hypothesis [C],其余三项 [D](AI Scientist v2 by Sakana AI + ChatGPT润色);Observed AI Limitations自曝"struggled to generate novel or complex experimental ideas"、"references focus on well-known established literature and the AI agent was unable to cite the latest or most directly relevant prior works"(自认引用有缺口)。Open access [No]:为保持"fully autonomous"未放AI agent代码。Statistical significance [No](无error bar)。贡献采用论文自声明C1-C4四条。
